findings.detail: Parenthesized negative cost and fair value on unfunded debt rows were extracted as positive magnitudes, creating false positive appreciation ratios.

rationale: X07 flagged six non-equity rows where extracted positive fair value exceeded 10x extracted positive cost. The raw SOI rows are unfunded debt investments with parenthesized negative cost and fair value, for example source cost (1) and fair value (19), cost (3) and fair value (31)/(47), cost (5) and fair value (55)/(162), and cost (8) and fair value (109). The source therefore does not support positive appreciation; it supports a sign-preservation extraction error.
